title: Imported executable plan contract
rules: Import preserves the source path, source hash, title, ordered tasks, dependencies, and acceptance checks.
Missing task ids are generated deterministically from the plan id and heading order.
Import never starts a provider, agent, device, or write action.
Start requires explicit approval for the exact source hash and revision.
Pause stops new dispatch; resume continues the same plan id and task ids.
Completed tasks are never dispatched again after restart or resume.
Interrupted tasks resume the same child when supported or become an explicit retry attempt.
No more than two root tasks run concurrently; excess ready tasks remain queued.
Every automatic route records candidates, required capabilities, capacity, cost, rationale, and isolation.
A user provider, model, agent, skill, tool, or isolation override is authoritative.
A Watch-held route is never called; fallback requires a recorded reason and remains within the approved plan.
Visual UI and UX tasks require a bounded Kimi K3 visual route unless the user overrides or accepts an explicit unavailable result.
Peer requests and replies carry plan id, task id, immutable sender and target ids, correlation id, reply id, and attempt.
